title: How to update WPBakery or Slider Revolution
issue: How to update wpbakery or slider revolution?
solution:
Any time the plugin is updated, you will find the latest version of the plugin in the config/plugins (or includes/admin/plugins) folder of your theme.

Please note that we need several days to test the compatibility with our themes, and if the new plugin version doesn't include important updates, it may take more time before we update all our themes.

To update the plugin, you can simply deactivate & delete the plugin from your WordPress plugin panel, then reinstall the new version via the "Appearance" > "Install Plugins" panel. You will find more info here: https://wolfthemes.ticksy.com/article/11671/

title: Theme animations not working with Elementor Pro header
issue: All the animation doesn't work (appears on scroll / svg animation ecc) but the classic elementor animation works perfectly.
solution: This may happen because the Elementor Pro custom header replaces the theme’s header.php, which prevents required scripts from loading. Use a Content Block for the header instead: https://wolfthemes.ticksy.com/article/12792/

title: Speaker Update from old version (prior to 2.0)
issue: I updated from an old version of Speaker and I can't retrieve my content.
solution: Speaker (2.0.0) has been re-designed a couple of years ago. The whole home page is now managed via Elementor in one single place. Users updating from older versions may need to manually rebuild the homepage layout.

title: Instagram feed not displaying like the demo
issue: How do I make the Instagram feed look like the demo? It's not pulling the right images and shows a blank screen.
solution: To customize your Instagram feed to match the demo, open the Smash Balloon Instagram Feed plugin and go to Feed > Customize tab > Sections. For layout and media display, use the Images and Videos section. If you still see a blank screen, try clearing your browser cache and the plugin cache. For more help, contact the plugin author: https://smashballoon.com/instagram-feed/support/

title: Outdated WooCommerce template files need updating
issue: I got a notification saying that the theme contains outdated copies of some WooCommerce template files.
solution: An update that will include the latest WooCommerce template version is already planned. In the meantime, this notification does not affect the theme's functionality, so you can safely ignore the message.

title: PHP warnings preventing the theme to work correctly - if they are related to our themes or theme-related plugins)
issue: I am getting errors on my website.
solution: I’ll look into this and release a fix as soon as possible. In the meantime, I recommend disabling any PHP debug tools on your production site. These warnings are intended for developers and shouldn’t affect how the theme or plugin function.
